name: "The" after "&" is judged
why: "Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band" would be flagged. Must fail on the stamped-titles test (a fixture title) and the shared cases.

why: File names such as "[80's Prom Night 12.mp3]" would be flagged. Must fail on the shared cases.

name: the series rule fires after "&"
why: "Greatest Hits, Volume I & Volume II" would get a comma before its second volume. Must fail on the shared cases.
